title: Operational Transformation & CRDT Collaboration
learningObjectives: Compare Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs) with Operational Transformation (OT)
Resolve concurrent conflicting edits without a single centralized locking authority
Structure document state trees and local optimistic mutation playback
keyTradeoffs: CRDT metadata memory overhead vs OT central server coordination requirements
Character-by-character synchronization vs block-level document updates
commonPitfalls: Assuming client clocks are synchronized when ordering concurrent edits
Unbounded tombstone growth in memory for deleted document nodes in CRDT structures
transferPrompt: How do you persist collaborative document states into a database while preserving undo/redo history?
